terra.problem: “The Crime Told to Israel” takes place at Mizpah, not Gibeah. It recounts a crime at Gibeah, but the Levite’s report and Israel’s decision happen at the assembly in Mizpah.
Some wording is above a fifth-grade level, including “concubine,” “atrocity,” “ambush,” “men of valor,” and “put the whole city to the sword.” Use simpler wording or brief explanations.
